title: tsp.tracker.ready
description: Tracker → TSP. Tracker is ready and asks for a handoff code. May be sent again at any time; TSP answers every one.

version.description: Contract version. A number, not a string.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters). New for every ready. TSP passes it to POST /v1/tracker/handoff as state.

reason.description: Why Tracker is asking. Informational: TSP handles every reason the same way.
